      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,

      "rationale": "Removing time-based transaction expiry fixes an incentive-incompatible eviction policy where 92% of expired transactions were shown to be mined later. It also removes the CTxMemPool entry_time multi-index container, eliminating an O(log n) tree maintenance cost on every insertion and deletion."
